title: Scalar restriction and open extension commute with their constant-diagram limit mates
statement: For a Noetherian adic datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], a quasi-compact open j:U→T, and any derived strict tower X of completed-ring modules on U, the square formed by the specified scalar/open comparison and the four constant-diagram adjunction mates commutes. Explicitly, restriction of the completed-ring open/limit mate, followed by scalar/limit at JX and the derived limit of tower scalar/open, equals derived scalar/open at Rlim X, followed by constant-ring open extension of scalar/limit at X and the constant-ring open/limit comparison. No completeness is assumed and equality is before any evaluation.

source.place: Tags 05S7 and 07A7, exact localization and adjunction transposition; agent refinement for the constant-diagram square.

proof.text: The exact scalar/open isomorphism gives a cube with constant-diagram comparisons on four edges. Its ordinary component equation is naturality of that isomorphism. Localization preserves the cube, by the exact-cube theorem used in UnboundedExactAdjunctionSquare.constant_cube. Invert its three-factor path equality to orient the four constants for taking mates.

source.place: Tags 05S7 and 07A7, exact localization and adjunction transposition; agent refinement for the constant-diagram square.

proof.text: Apply exchangeMate_cube to the four constant-diagram/derived-limit adjunctions. Its four mate edges are precisely the four cbcRealizationLimitMap maps. Specialize to open extension, ambient scalar restriction, open scalar restriction, and constant-ring open extension. The derived ordinary and tower square comparisons agree with the published scalar/open definitions by their exact localization formulas.

theorem completedOpenScalarLimitSquare {U T : Scheme.{t}} (j : U ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (X : DerivedCategory (exchangeTowers U (d.completedRing U))) :
    (cbcRealizationRes d T).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((cbcRealizationLimitMap (cbcOpenShriek d j inferInstance)).app X) ≫
      (cbcRealizationResLimit d T).hom.app ((cbcRealizationJ d j).obj X) ≫
      (completedRlim T (exchangeConstantRing T A)).map
        ((cbcRealizationTowerScalarOpen d j).hom.app X) =
    (cbcRealizationDerivedScalarOpen d j).hom.app
        ((completedRlim U (d.completedRing U)).obj X) ≫
      (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleJ A j).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((cbcRealizationResLimit d U).hom.app X) ≫
      (cbcRealizationOpenLimit d j).hom.app ((exchangeTowerRes d U).obj X)
